THE ARTICULATION AGREEMENT BELOW IS SUBJECT TO PERIODIC REVISION. PLEASE CONSULT A COUNSELOR EVERY SEMESTER TO OBTAIN CURRENT INFORMATION ABOUT POSSIBLE CHANGES IN THE AGREEMENT.


Admissions and Transfer Information


Academic Advising

It is recommended students meet with an advisor each semester.


Minimum Grade of C

All courses counted toward the major, including preparation for the major courses, must be completed with a letter grade of C (2.0) or better. Credit/No Credit grading is not accepted.


Language Proficiency Requirement

For some majors, students must meet a second-language proficiency requirement. This is satisfied with the first semester of an intermediate language or demonstrating proficiency in a language other than English. For details on how to satisfy this requirement, please refer to Language Proficiency Requirement.

The minimum acceptable Pre-Business core GPA is a 2.65 (minimum GPA subject to change each academic year). However, if your GPA falls between 2.5 and 2.65, you may be subject to a waitlist for business status. Students who are waitlisted for business status are encouraged to repeat courses in which they received a 'C' in order to raise their grade and their GPA for future consideration of business status .Courses CANNOT be taken for Credit/No Credit Grading Please Note: ACCT and BUS courses completed more than 10 years ago must be repeated.


Special Note: CSUSM will accept the equivalents of ACCT 201 and ACCT 202 as substitution for ACCT 203 and BUS 101. Both ACCT 201 and ACCT 202 must be completed in order for the substitution to be allowed. Please filter Assist by department to see if your institution has articulation with ACCT 201 and ACCT 202.
